**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The licence grant in Section 3.1(a) satisfies the preferred position on every material term:

- **Scope/affiliates/contractors:** §3.4(a) allows us to exercise rights through any Affiliate without RevMed's consent; §3.4(b) permits multi-tier sublicensing to Third Parties; §3.4(c) permits subcontracting as we deem appropriate.
- **Not revocable at will:** RevMed's termination rights are limited to uncured material breach, insolvency, and the defined Competing Product / cessation-of-development triggers, each with notice and cure — no discretionary revocation.
- **Perpetual on paid-up:** on expiration the licence becomes "fully paid up, royalty free, perpetual and irrevocable" (§12.3(b)).
- **Successor transfer:** §15.2(a)(ii) lets us assign without consent in an M&A or substantially-all-assets sale, and §15.2(a)(i) permits intra-Affiliate assignment.

Noted but not flagged: consent (not unreasonably withheld) is needed to sublicense substantially all US rights under §3.4(b)(ii), and §§12.2(d)–(e) give RevMed termination triggers slightly beyond pure material breach — minor sub-elements that do not fail the fallback.
